title: Implement log rotation for unified logging
description:
Add log rotation to the logs package to prevent unbounded disk usage. Features needed:
- MaxSize option for log files (default 10MB)
- Rotate logs when size exceeded
- Keep N rotated logs (default 5)
- Compress old logs
- Update logs.EnsureDir to handle rotation setup

Acceptance criteria:
- Log files rotate when MaxSize is reached
- Old logs are compressed with gzip
- Oldest logs are deleted when max count exceeded
- Tests verify rotation behavior

title: Add foundry logs test coverage
description:
Add tests for the internal/logs package and cmd/foundry/logs.go command. Include:
- Unit tests for LogDir, SessionLogPath, WorkerLogPath, LeaderLogPath
- Test EnsureDir creates directories properly
- Test ListLogs with different filters
- Test CleanLogs removes old files correctly
- Integration test for foundry logs command

Acceptance criteria:
- 80%+ code coverage for internal/logs/
- All path functions tested
- Clean/list functions tested
- Command works correctly
